text:
You need a WordPress booking form that can handle weather, service selection with price calculation, live availability by date/time, account access, distance calculation, and a custom page template with multiple block designs.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’ve spent 7 years building full-stack web apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Stripe. In a recent Clinic patient portal project, I built booking, lab results, and SMS reminders with audit logging; it supported 11k patients registered and helped reduce no-shows by 18%.

For your site, I can recreate the order-form flow, build the pricing logic, connect availability rules, and structure the page template cleanly so it’s easy to manage in WordPress. I can also help map the distance calculation and account functionality into a practical implementation.

Would you like this built as a custom WordPress plugin or adapted into your existing theme setup?
